title: Amazon Desires to Spend More Than $220 Billion in AI Capex This Year. That’s Why I’m Buying
excerpt: Amazon just handed investors a Q2 earnings report that raised a question most analysts are tiptoeing around: when a company at nearly $3 trillion in market c...
content_html:
Alex Sirois

Mon, August 3, 2026 at 11:58 AM EDT 4 min read

Quick Read

  • AWS reached $42 billion in Q2 2026 revenue, up 37% year over year, with AI and chip businesses each hitting $25 billion annual run rates.

  • AMZN beats MSFT and GOOGL on contracted demand: Anthropic and OpenAI have signed Trainium capacity commitments with AWS sold out through 2027.

  • Amazon's free cash flow turned negative at -$7.6 billion as capex consumed 138% of first-half operating cash flow, but AI demand is contractually locked in.

  • Act now: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just named his top 10 AI stocks — and Amazon didn't make the cut. Grab the names FREE today.

I keep buying Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN), and the July 30, 2026 earnings report gave me another reason to keep the buy button warm. When a company at a $2.921 trillion market cap accelerates its cloud business to its fastest pace in 18 quarters while committing to what looks like more than $220 billion in capital spending this year, I read that as a demand problem I want to own.

The thesis in plain English: Amazon is building AI capacity to fulfill contracts customers have already signed. Anthropic committed up to 5 GW of Trainium chip capacity, OpenAI committed roughly 2 GW of Trainium capacity beginning 2027, and Amazon Bedrock customers spent more in Q2 than all prior quarters combined. AWS carries a $496B contracted backlog, which is the receipt for the spending.

Three Reasons the Conviction Holds

First, AWS growth. Segment revenue reached $42.23 billion in Q2 2026, up 37% year over year, at a 39.4% operating margin. Andy Jassy told investors that Amazon's "AI and Chips businesses each eclipsed run rates of more than $25 billion." That is a booked run rate compounding at triple-digit percentages.

Act now: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just named his top 10 AI stocks — and Amazon didn't make the cut. Grab the names FREE today.

Second, the earnings power funding the buildout. Q2 operating income rose 43.24% to $27.461 billion. EPS came in at $5.75 against a $1.8227 estimate, a 215.47% beat. Full-year 2025 operating cash flow reached $139.514 billion. The balance sheet absorbs the strain: net debt to EBITDA of 0.45, interest coverage of 35.17x, and shareholders' equity at $551.62 billion.

Third, the capex trajectory. H1 2026 capex hit $98.411 billion. Q2 alone was $54.208 billion, up 68.44% year over year. Polymarket traders assign a 62.5% probability that 2026 capex clears $220 billion. A hyperscaler outrunning its own capex guide because customers keep asking for more is the signal I want to see.

快速阅读

  • AWS 2026 年第二季度收入达到 420 亿美元，同比增长 37%，人工智能和芯片业务的年运行率分别达到 250 亿美元。
  • AMZN 在合同需求方面击败了 MSFT 和 GOOGL：Anthropic 和 OpenAI 已与 AWS 签署了 Trainium 容量承诺，承诺在 2027 年售完。
  • 由于资本支出消耗了上半年运营现金流的 138%，亚马逊的自由现金流变为负值，为 76 亿美元，但人工智能需求已被合同锁定。
  • 立即行动：2010 年给 NVIDIA 打电话的分析师刚刚列出了他心目中的十大人工智能股票，而亚马逊并未上榜。 今天免费获取名字。

我一直在买入亚马逊（NASDAQ：AMZN），2026 年 7 月 30 日的收益报告给了我另一个保持买入按钮的理由。 当一家市值 2.921 万亿美元的公司将其云业务加速至 18 个季度以来最快的速度，同时承诺今年的资本支出似乎超过 2200 亿美元时，我将其视为我想要解决的需求问题。

这篇论文用简单的英语来说：亚马逊正在建设人工智能能力来履行客户已经签署的合同。 Anthropic 承诺提供高达 5 GW 的 Trainium 芯片产能，OpenAI 承诺从 2027 年开始提供约 2 GW 的 Trainium 芯片产能，Amazon Bedrock 客户在第二季度的支出超过了之前所有季度的总和。 AWS 拥有 496B 美元的合同积压订单，这是支出的收据。

定罪成立的三个理由

首先，AWS 的增长。 2026 年第二季度，该部门收入达到 422.3 亿美元，同比增长 37%，营业利润率为 39.4%。 安迪·贾西 (Andy Jassy) 告诉投资者，亚马逊的“人工智能和芯片业务的运行率均超过 250 亿美元”。 这是按三位数百分比复利计算的预订运行率。

立即行动：2010 年给 NVIDIA 打电话的分析师刚刚列出了他心目中的十大人工智能股票，而亚马逊并未上榜。 今天免费获取名字。

其次，盈利能力为扩建提供资金。 第二季度营业收入增长 43.24% 至 274.61 亿美元。 每股收益为 5.75 美元，而预期为 1.8227 美元，高出 215.47%。 2025年全年经营现金流达到1395.14亿美元。 资产负债表吸收了压力：净债务与 EBITDA 之比为 0.45，利息保障倍数为 35.17 倍，股东权益为 5,516.2 亿美元。

第三，资本支出轨迹。 2026 年上半年资本支出达到 984.11 亿美元。 仅第二季度就实现了 542.08 亿美元，同比增长 68.44%。 Polymarket 交易员预计 2026 年资本支出达到 2200 亿美元的可能性为 62.5%。 由于客户不断要求更多，超大规模企业超出了自己的资本支出指南，这是我希望看到的信号。
